versos.grego: Ἀποθέμενοι οὖν πᾶσαν κακίαν καὶ πάντα δόλον καὶ ὑποκρίσεις καὶ φθόνους καὶ πάσας καταλαλιάς,

controles.web: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,
controles.kjv: Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,
controles.livre: Abandonai, portanto, toda malícia, toda enganação, fingimentos, invejas, e todas as falas maldosas,

versos.grego: ὡς ἀρτιγέννητα βρέφη τὸ λογικὸν ἄδολον γάλα ἐπιποθήσατε, ἵνα ἐν αὐτῷ αὐξηθῆτε εἰς σωτηρίαν,

controles.web: as newborn babies, long for the pure milk of the Word, that with it you may grow,
controles.kjv: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:
controles.livre: e desejai ansiosamente, como bebês recém-nascidos, o leite da Palavra, não falsificado, para que por meio dele estejais crescendo para a salvação;

versos.grego: εἰ ἐγεύσασθε ὅτι χρηστὸς ὁ Κύριος.

controles.web: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious:
controles.kjv: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
controles.livre: se, de fato, já experimentastes que o Senhor é bom.

versos.grego: πρὸς ὃν προσερχόμενοι, λίθον ζῶντα, ὑπὸ ἀνθρώπων μὲν ἀποδεδοκιμασμένον παρὰ δὲ Θεῷ ἐκλεκτὸν ἔντιμον,

controles.web: coming to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.
controles.kjv: To whom coming, as unto a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, and precious,
controles.livre: Aproximai-vos dele, que é uma pedra viva, rejeitada pelos seres humanos, mas escolhida e preciosa para Deus.

versos.grego: καὶ αὐτοὶ ὡς λίθοι ζῶντες οἰκοδομεῖσθε οἶκος πνευματικὸς εἰς ἱεράτευμα ἅγιον, ἀνενέγκαι πνευματικὰς θυσίας εὐπροσδέκτους Θεῷ διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: You also, as living stones, are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
controles.kjv: Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.
controles.livre: Também vós, como pedras vivas, sois edificados como casa espiritual e sacerdócio santo, para oferecerdes sacrifícios espirituais, agradáveis a Deus por meio de Jesus Cristo.

versos.grego: διότι περιέχει ἐν γραφῇ Ἰδοὺ τίθημι ἐν Σιὼν λίθον ἐκλεκτὸν ἀκρογωνιαῖον ἔντιμον, καὶ ὁ πιστεύων ἐπ’ αὐτῷ οὐ μὴ καταισχυνθῇ.

controles.web: Because it is contained in Scripture,  “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen, and precious: He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”
controles.kjv: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded.
controles.livre: Pois também está contido na Escritura: Eis que eu ponho em Sião uma pedra principal de esquina, escolhida e preciosa. Quem nela crer de maneira nenhuma será envergonhado.

versos.grego: ὑμῖν οὖν ἡ τιμὴ τοῖς πιστεύουσιν· ἀπιστοῦσιν δὲ λίθος ὃν ἀπεδοκίμασαν οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες, οὗτος ἐγενήθη εἰς κεφαλὴν γωνίας

controles.web: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient,  “The stone which the builders rejected, has become the chief cornerstone,”
controles.kjv: Unto you therefore which believe he is precious: but unto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner,
controles.livre: Assim, para vós, que credes, ela é preciosa. Mas para os incrédulos: A pedra que os construtores rejeitaram, essa se tornou a principal de esquina,

versos.grego: καὶ λίθος προσκόμματος καὶ πέτρα σκανδάλου· οἳ προσκόπτουσιν τῷ λόγῳ ἀπειθοῦντες, εἰς ὃ καὶ ἐτέθησαν·

controles.web: and,  “a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offense.”    For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.
controles.kjv: And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, even to them which stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.
controles.livre: assim como: pedra de tropeço, e pedra que leva à queda. Eles tropeçam na palavra por serem rebeldes. Para isso eles foram destinados.

versos.grego: ὑμεῖς δὲ γένος ἐκλεκτόν, βασίλειον ἱεράτευμα, ἔθνος ἅγιον, λαὸς εἰς περιποίησιν, ὅπως τὰς ἀρετὰς ἐξαγγείλητε τοῦ ἐκ σκότους ὑμᾶς καλέσαντος εἰς τὸ θαυμαστὸν αὐτοῦ φῶς·

controles.web: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light:
controles.kjv: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
controles.livre: Mas vós sois a geração escolhida, o sacerdócio real, a nação santa, e o povo adquirido; a fim de que anuncieis as virtudes daquele que vos chamou das trevas para a sua maravilhosa luz.

versos.grego: οἵ ποτε οὐ λαὸς, νῦν δὲ λαὸς Θεοῦ, οἱ οὐκ ἠλεημένοι, νῦν δὲ ἐλεηθέντες.

controles.web: who in time past were no people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
controles.kjv: Which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of God: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
controles.livre: Antes, vós não éreis povo, mas agora sois povo de Deus. Antes , não havíeis recebido misericórdia, mas agora recebestes misericórdia.

versos.grego: Ἀγαπητοί, παρακαλῶ ὡς παροίκους καὶ παρεπιδήμους ἀπέχεσθαι τῶν σαρκικῶν ἐπιθυμιῶν, αἵτινες στρατεύονται κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς·

controles.web: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims, to abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
controles.kjv: Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
controles.livre: Amados, como a peregrinos e estrangeiros, eu vos peço que vos abstenhais dos desejos carnais, que batalham contra a alma,

versos.grego: τὴν ἀναστροφὴν ὑμῶν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἔχοντες καλήν, ἵνα ἐν ᾧ καταλαλοῦσιν ὑμῶν ὡς κακοποιῶν, ἐκ τῶν καλῶν ἔργων ἐποπτεύοντες δοξάσωσιν τὸν Θεὸν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπισκοπῆς.

controles.web: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they see, glorify God in the day of visitation.
controles.kjv: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.
controles.livre: e que tenhais um bom comportamento vosso entre os pagãos; para que, naquilo que de vós, como de malfeitores, falam mal, no dia da visitação glorifiquem a Deus por causa das vossas boas obras que virem.

versos.grego: Ὑποτάγητε πάσῃ ἀνθρωπίνῃ κτίσει διὰ τὸν Κύριον· εἴτε βασιλεῖ ὡς ὑπερέχοντι,

controles.web: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme;
controles.kjv: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;
controles.livre: Sujeitai-vos a toda autoridade humana, por causa do Senhor; seja ao rei, como superior;

versos.grego: εἴτε ἡγεμόσιν ὡς δι’ αὐτοῦ πεμπομένοις εἰς ἐκδίκησιν κακοποιῶν ἔπαινον δὲ ἀγαθοποιῶν·

controles.web: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.
controles.kjv: Or unto governors, as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well.
controles.livre: seja aos governantes, como enviados por ele, com o objetivo de castigar os malfeitores, e de conceder honra aos que fazem o bem.

versos.grego: ὅτι οὕτως ἐστὶν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Θεοῦ, ἀγαθοποιοῦντας φιμοῦν τὴν τῶν ἀφρόνων ἀνθρώπων ἀγνωσίαν·

controles.web: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
controles.kjv: For so is the will of God, that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
controles.livre: Pois esta é a vontade de Deus, que, ao fazerdes o bem, caleis a ignorância dos homens tolos.

versos.grego: ὡς ἐλεύθεροι, καὶ μὴ ὡς ἐπικάλυμμα ἔχοντες τῆς κακίας τὴν ἐλευθερίαν, ἀλλ’ ὡς Θεοῦ δοῦλοι.

controles.web: as free, and not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.
controles.kjv: As free, and not using your liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of God.
controles.livre: Comportai-vos como pessoas livres, mas não useis a liberdade como pretexto para a malícia. Em vez disso, sede como servos de Deus.

versos.grego: πάντας τιμήσατε, τὴν ἀδελφότητα ἀγαπᾶτε, τὸν Θεὸν φοβεῖσθε, τὸν βασιλέα τιμᾶτε.

controles.web: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.
controles.kjv: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.
controles.livre: Honrai a todos: amai aos irmãos, temei a Deus, honrai ao rei.

versos.grego: Οἱ οἰκέται, ὑποτασσόμενοι ἐν παντὶ φόβῳ τοῖς δεσπόταις, οὐ μόνον τοῖς ἀγαθοῖς καὶ ἐπιεικέσιν ἀλλὰ καὶ τοῖς σκολιοῖς.

controles.web: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.
controles.kjv: Servants, be subject to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.
controles.livre: Servos, sujeitai-vos com todo temor aos vossos senhores, não somente aos bons e brandos, mas também aos que maltratam.

versos.grego: τοῦτο γὰρ χάρις εἰ διὰ συνείδησιν Θεοῦ ὑποφέρει τις λύπας πάσχων ἀδίκως.

controles.web: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.
controles.kjv: For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully.
controles.livre: Pois coisa agradável é se alguém, por causa da consciência a respeito de Deus, experimente dores, sofrendo injustamente.

versos.grego: ποῖον γὰρ κλέος εἰ ἁμαρτάνοντες καὶ κολαφιζόμενοι ὑπομενεῖτε; ἀλλ’ εἰ ἀγαθοποιοῦντες καὶ πάσχοντες ὑπομενεῖτε, τοῦτο χάρις παρὰ Θεῷ.

controles.web: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if, when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.
controles.kjv: For what glory is it, if, when ye be buffeted for your faults, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer for it, ye take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.
controles.livre: Afinal, que mérito há em suportar serdes espancados por cometerdes pecado? Contudo, se, quando fazeis o bem, sois afligidos e suportais, isso é a Deus.

versos.grego: εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ ἐκλήθητε, ὅτι καὶ Χριστὸς ἔπαθεν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν, ὑμῖν ὑπολιμπάνων ὑπογραμμὸν ἵνα ἐπακολουθήσητε τοῖς ἴχνεσιν αὐτοῦ·

controles.web: For to this you were called, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,
controles.kjv: For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps:
controles.livre: Pois para isto fostes chamados, porque também Cristo sofreu por vós,  deixando-vos exemplo, para que sigais os seus passos.

versos.grego: ὃς ἁμαρτίαν οὐκ ἐποίησεν οὐδὲ εὑρέθη δόλος ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτοῦ·

controles.web: who did not sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”
controles.kjv: Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:
controles.livre: Ele não cometeu pecado, nem engano foi achado em sua boca.

versos.grego: ὃς λοιδορούμενος οὐκ ἀντελοιδόρει, πάσχων οὐκ ἠπείλει, παρεδίδου δὲ τῷ κρίνοντι δικαίως·

controles.web: Who, when he was cursed, didn’t curse back. When he suffered, didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously;
controles.kjv: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously:
controles.livre: Quando o insultavam, ele não insultava de volta. Quando sofria, ele não ameaçava; em vez disso, entregava-se ao que julga de maneira justa.

versos.grego: ὃς τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἡμῶν αὐτὸς ἀνήνεγκεν ἐν τῷ σώματι αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸ ξύλον, ἵνα ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ἀπογενόμενοι τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ ζήσωμεν· οὗ τῷ μώλωπι ἰάθητε.

controles.web: who his own self bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness; by whose stripes you were healed.
controles.kjv: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.
controles.livre: Ele levou nossos pecados em seu próprio corpo sobre o madeiro; para que nós, estando mortos para os pecados, vivamos para a justiça. Pela ferida dele fostes sarados.

versos.grego: ἦτε γὰρ ὡς πρόβατα πλανώμενοι, ἀλλὰ ἐπεστράφητε νῦν ἐπὶ τὸν Ποιμένα καὶ Ἐπίσκοπον τῶν ψυχῶν ὑμῶν.

controles.web: For you were going astray like sheep; but now have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
controles.kjv: For ye were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.
controles.livre: Porque vós éreis como ovelhas desviadas do caminho; mas agora vós estais convertidos ao Pastor e Supervisor de vossas almas.
